collections.name: Portraits
collections.blurb: Headshots, engagements, and graduations. Including the residency application photo you only want to sit for once.

collections.name: Events
collections.blurb: Openings, banquets, department events, and parades, including official coverage of the 2026 Arts in the Dark Parade. Hospitals and campus buildings are familiar ground.

collections.name: Product & Brand
collections.blurb: Food, packaging, and pop-up tables. The work small businesses actually need, shot in daylight where the product allows it.

collections.name: Calligraphy
collections.blurb: Arabic script by hand, in ink on paper. Invitations, names, signage, and gifts.

collections.name: Chicago
collections.blurb: The city I live in and keep photographing: river, lake, glass and weather.

collections.name: New York
collections.blurb: Nights on foot with one lens. Street corners, bridges, and everything still open at 2 a.m.

collections.name: Travel
collections.blurb: Jordan, Japan, and the Midwest by car. Ruins at sunrise, rooftops at noon, and a market in Tokyo that does not close.

collections.name: Nature
collections.blurb: Smoky Mountain creeks, Wisconsin and Illinois sandstone, and whatever holds still long enough.

collections.name: Sammer
collections.blurb: Photographs of me, taken by other people.
